degraded.detail: shared/tests was terminated by the environment at 79%, then 94%, then 94% again - including one run deliberately detached from the session. ZERO failing tests in every attempt, and no Windows crash event for any of them. Memory pressure, a duplicated WebUI server and the pty idle-reaper were each investigated and FALSIFIED. The remainder of shared/tests is therefore unverified locally and is verified by CI as a Required Check on this PR.

The Step-8 cascade was started twice and lost twice to the same environment fault. Substituted on the operator's instruction with two independent rounds of external_review.py --mode code, which returned 11 findings; 7 were fixed in-diff, three of them high.

ci_supplychain_ack.statement: Adds no action and changes no pin: the third-party setup-uv stays SHA-pinned and GitHub-owned actions stay on mutable tags, exactly as ADR-118 decided. Three trust-boundary changes, each narrowing rather than widening it. On main the concurrency group becomes per-commit with cancelling off (ci.yml, security.yml), so every merge is verified instead of a later one cancelling an earlier one's checks. bloat-check gains a push-to-main trigger with a guarded base ref (empty, all-zero and unresolvable bases are detected rather than diffed against). And ci.yml gains ONE gating step, conditional on the fix-main-* repair convention, which materialises its checker from pull_request.base.sha and runs THAT against the PR tree — so a repair pull request cannot be judged by a checker it just edited. Token permissions are unchanged: read-only at the top level, no job widens itself.
